metadata.home_title: PuzzleSolver — Free Online Logic Puzzle Solvers
metadata.home_description: Solve any logic puzzle instantly. Free online solvers for Tango, Battleship, Skyscraper, Slitherlink and more — no signup, works on mobile.
metadata.tango_title: Tango Puzzle Solver — Free Online LinkedIn Tango Solver
metadata.tango_description: Solve LinkedIn's Tango puzzle instantly. Fill the grid with suns and moons under the balance, no three in a row, and equals or not equals constraints. All solutions found automatically.
metadata.battleship_title: Battleship Puzzle Solver — Free Online Bimaru Solver
metadata.battleship_description: Solve Battleship (Bimaru) grid puzzles instantly. Enter the row and column ship count clues and any cell hints, then auto solve via constraint based deduction.
metadata.skyscraper_title: Skyscraper Puzzle Solver — Free Online Skyscraper Solver
metadata.skyscraper_description: Solve Skyscraper logic puzzles instantly. Enter the edge clues (how many buildings are visible from each side) and the constraint solver fills the grid automatically.
metadata.slitherlink_title: Slitherlink Puzzle Solver — Free Online Loop Puzzle Solver
metadata.slitherlink_description: Solve Slitherlink (loop) puzzles instantly. Enter the number clues and the solver draws the single closed loop that satisfies every cell, with multi solution browsing.

tango.title: LinkedIn Tango Puzzle Solver
tango.description: Free online Tango puzzle solver inspired by LinkedIn's daily puzzle game. Fill the grid with suns ☀️ and moons 🌙 following the rules. Supports multiple grid sizes!
tango.solutions_found: 🔢 {count, plural, one {# solution} other {# solutions}} found
tango.notif_no_solution_msg: This puzzle appears to be unsolvable with the given constraints.
tango.notif_error_msg: An error occurred while solving the puzzle. Please try again.
tango.howto_goal_fill: Fill the {size}×{size} grid with suns ☀️ and moons 🌙
tango.howto_goal_balance_even: Each row and column must contain exactly {half} suns and {half} moons
tango.howto_goal_balance_odd: Each row and column must contain {floor} or {ceil} of each symbol (difference of at most 1)
tango.howto_rule_adjacent: No more than two identical symbols may be adjacent
tango.howto_rule_equal: Cells with <eq>=</eq> between them must contain the same symbol
tango.howto_rule_different: Cells with <neq>≠</neq> between them must contain different symbols
tango.howto_use_click_cell: Click on any cell to place suns ☀️ or moons 🌙
tango.howto_use_click_between: Click between cells to add constraints (= or ≠)
tango.howto_use_click_solve: Click "🧩 Solve Puzzle" to automatically solve the current puzzle
tango.contact_subtitle: Have a puzzle type you'd like us to add? Found a bug? We'd love to hear from you!
tango.contact_note1: This Tango puzzle solver was created with passion for puzzle games and web development.
tango.contact_note2: If you enjoy this puzzle solver, consider connecting or supporting future development!

battleship.title: Battleship Puzzle Solver
battleship.description: Free online Battleship puzzle solver with interactive grid. Place ships according to row/column clues. Ships cannot touch each other, even diagonally.
battleship.alert_no_solution: No solution found. Please check your clues.
battleship.alert_error: Error solving puzzle. Please check your clues.
battleship.howto_place: Place ships on the grid according to the row and column count clues
battleship.howto_touch: Ships cannot touch each other, not even diagonally
battleship.howto_dropdown: Use the dropdown menus to place ship parts or water
battleship.howto_fleet: Standard fleet: 1×4 battleship, 2×3 cruisers, 3×2 destroyers, 4×1 submarines
battleship.howto_numbers: Numbers around the edge show how many ship segments are in that row/column
battleship.howto_click_solve: Click "Solve Puzzle" to automatically solve the current puzzle
battleship.about_note1: This Battleship puzzle solver was created with passion for puzzle games and web development.
battleship.about_note2: If you enjoy this puzzle solver, consider connecting or supporting future development!

skyscraper.title: Skyscraper Puzzle Solver
skyscraper.description: Enter the edge clues — each counts how many skyscrapers are visible from that side — and solve the grid automatically.
skyscraper.msg_none: No solution found. Check that the clues are consistent.
skyscraper.msg_many: Found 10+ solutions (showing the first 10) — add more clues to narrow it down.
skyscraper.msg_error: Something went wrong while solving. Please review the clues.
skyscraper.howto_fill: Fill the grid with heights 1 to {size}, each used once per row and column.
skyscraper.howto_clue: A clue counts how many buildings are visible from that edge — taller ones hide shorter ones behind them.
skyscraper.howto_blank: Leave a clue blank if it is not given. Four edges are supported: top, bottom, left, right.

slitherlink.title: Slitherlink Puzzle Solver
slitherlink.description: Free online Slitherlink puzzle solver with interactive grid. Draw a single continuous loop where number clues indicate how many edges around each cell are part of the loop. Click edges to draw lines or mark with X.
slitherlink.solutions_found: 🔢 {count, plural, one {# solution} other {# solutions}} found
slitherlink.multiple_warning: ⚠️ Multiple solutions detected! This puzzle may need additional clues for uniqueness.
slitherlink.notif_unsolvable_msg: This puzzle appears to be unsolvable. Please check your clues and try again.
slitherlink.notif_error_msg: An error occurred while solving the puzzle. Please try again.
slitherlink.notif_copied_msg: Grid has been copied to clipboard
slitherlink.notif_copy_failed_msg: Failed to copy grid to clipboard
slitherlink.notif_clipboard_unavailable_msg: Clipboard not available in this browser
slitherlink.dialog_intro: This puzzle is taking longer than expected to solve.
slitherlink.dialog_reason_1: The puzzle has too many possible solutions (under constrained)
slitherlink.dialog_reason_2: Some clues may be incorrect or contradictory
slitherlink.dialog_reason_3: The puzzle requires advanced loop finding techniques
slitherlink.dialog_reason_4: The grid size makes it computationally intensive
slitherlink.dialog_suggestion_1: Double check your clues for accuracy
slitherlink.dialog_suggestion_2: Try adding more number clues to constrain the solution
slitherlink.dialog_suggestion_3: Start with a smaller grid size
slitherlink.dialog_suggestion_4: Load an example puzzle to test the solver
slitherlink.howto_loop: Draw a single continuous loop by connecting dots
slitherlink.howto_numbers: Numbers in cells show how many edges around that cell are part of the loop
slitherlink.howto_cycle: Click edges to cycle through: empty, line, cross, empty
slitherlink.howto_lines: Lines are part of the loop, crosses mark edges that are NOT part of the loop
slitherlink.howto_input: Enter numbers (0 to 4) for clues, 's' for inside loop, 'w' for outside loop
slitherlink.howto_continuous: The loop must be continuous with no branches or isolated segments
slitherlink.howto_click_solve: Click "Solve Puzzle" to automatically solve the current puzzle
